decisions.reason: Premium customer support is very close to the core hosting business, likely uses existing support resources, and its low carrying cost makes the option worth keeping despite limited later evidence.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's platform and know-how, so even with ongoing maintenance costs it remains a strategically useful complement to the established offer.

The data processing contract tool is more distant from the firm's core hosting-services model, and with a broad product portfolio the firm is likely to reallocate attention and development effort to closer, higher-synergy options.

Scalable hosting for agencies fits the firm's agency-focused strategy exceptionally well and, in a growing market with ongoing hiring, is the kind of core offering management would be inclined to continue.
